PostToolUse.command: bash -c 'FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_PARAM_file_path"; if [[ "$FILE" == *.jsx ]] || [[ "$FILE" == *.js ]]; then node -c "$FILE" 2>&1 || echo "SYNTAX ERROR in $FILE" >&2; fi'
PostToolUse.description: Syntax-check JS/JSX files after every edit

PostSession.description: Log session end with last commit
